yaml.subtitle: Ways to experience the arboretum: nature, education and wellbeing

markdown.markdown:
```{=html}
Arboretum Home The Collection Map Self-guided tour Wellbeing Visit Sponsor a tree Donate Companies Contact Book a visit Español ▸
``` The Arboretum at Estancia La Constancia is open to experiences that combine **conservation, environmental education and wellbeing**. Choose the one that interests you most and we'll arrange a date. ::: {.callout-tip} Would you like to book or ask a question? Write to us from the [**Contact**](contact.html) page and we'll reply shortly. ::: ::: grid ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Guided and educational visits Tours led by professionals for **families, schools and groups**, adapted by level and goal. Ideal to complement natural science, biology and environmental education content. [See educational visits →](educational-visits.html){.btn .btn-success role="button"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Guided botanical group tours Guided walks through the arboretum's collections —conifers, broadleaf trees, shrubs and palms— for the general public, clubs, nurseries, gardeners and botany enthusiasts. [Book / enquire →](guided-tours.html){.btn .btn-success role="button"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Birdwatching Observation and photography outings for **birdwatchers and photographers**, guided by the estate's seasonal species record. [See the arboretum's birds →](birds.html){.btn .btn-outline-success role="button"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Wellbeing and forest bathing Guided nature-connection experiences (*shinrin-yoku*), backed by science, for individuals and teams looking to reduce stress and reconnect. [Learn more →](wellbeing.html){.btn .btn-success role="button"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Corporate programs Impact partnerships, wellbeing days, corporate volunteering and sponsorship of arboretum projects, with traceable and verifiable impact. [See the proposal for companies →](companies.html){.btn .btn-outline-success role="button"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### 🎉 Corporate events Team-building, offsites, celebrations and productions in a 33-hectare botanical garden, minutes from Mar del Plata. [See corporate events →](events.html){.btn .btn-success role="button"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### 🌱 Sponsor a tree Join conservation by sponsoring a specimen, in your own name, as a gift or in honour of someone. [Sponsor a tree →](sponsor.html){.btn .btn-outline-success role="button"} ::: ::: --- All experiences are **by advance booking**, to ensure good organization and the best experience for each group.
